nodes.name: .env.example
nodes.summary: Environment variable template defining all EQUITY_* configuration keys for database connection, blob storage (MinIO), deployment mode, and data-source adapter switches.
nodes.languageNotes: All keys are prefixed EQUITY_* per the project convention; EQUITY_DEPLOYMENT_MODE and EQUITY_WEB_SCRAPING_ENABLED act as master switches governing adapter behaviour.

nodes.name: CLAUDE.md
nodes.summary: Master system specification for the equity-knowledge project, defining the three non-negotiable rules (R1 deterministic compute, R2 as_of on everything, R3 model proposes / data disposes), the full tech stack, data model with 23 knowledge stores, decision-support logic, data sources, and code conventions.
nodes.languageNotes: 19 sections covering rules, stack, deployment, data model, decision support, integrations, sources, conventions, testing, and forbidden patterns. Serves as the authoritative behavioural contract for every Claude session.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Developer-facing quickstart covering Windows/PowerShell setup, ingest adapter CLI commands, repository layout, and database invariants enforced at the schema level.

nodes.name: Welcome.md
nodes.summary: Obsidian vault default welcome note; not part of the equity-knowledge project documentation and can be deleted.

nodes.name: alembic.ini
nodes.summary: Alembic database migration configuration pointing to the migrations/ directory, deferring the database URL to the EQUITY_DATABASE_URL environment variable via core.config, and configuring log levels for SQLAlchemy and Alembic.
nodes.languageNotes: sqlalchemy.url is intentionally left blank; the adapter pattern resolves it from the EQUITY_DATABASE_URL env var at runtime so secrets never live in the ini file.

nodes.name: getting-started-plan.md
nodes.summary: Week-by-week build plan for the MVP, detailing Claude Code session prompts for substrate setup, financial-fact ingestion, guidance extraction, and the working rhythm; also lists what must not be built before the stores have data.

nodes.name: pyproject.toml
nodes.summary: Python project manifest declaring the equity-knowledge package (Python >=3.12) with core dependencies (SQLAlchemy, Alembic, psycopg, Pydantic, boto3, httpx), optional dev dependencies (pytest, hypothesis), pytest test-path configuration, and setuptools package discovery limited to core* and ingest*.
nodes.languageNotes: Package discovery is explicitly scoped to core* and ingest* to prevent accidental inclusion of test or script directories.

nodes.name: requirements.txt
nodes.summary: Pinned exact-version dependency lockfile for reproducible venv rebuilds, covering Alembic, boto3, httpx, hypothesis, psycopg, Pydantic, pytest, SQLAlchemy, python-dotenv, and timezone data.
